label: Claude Sonnet 5.5

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Hi Victor, Jenna Cole from Brinewatch. Thanks for the time. What's going on with temperature on your side?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: The trailers are the problem. We run 25 reefer trailers out to 40 stores, and when a trailer sits at a store's dock waiting to be unloaded, the temperature creeps.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: What happens when it creeps?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: The store rejects the dairy or the produce and it comes back to us. We're eating about $8,000 a month in rejected product.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: And how do you find out a trailer drifted?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: After the fact, somebody downloads the reefer data when the trailer gets back, and by then the product's already been refused.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: So you have data, it's just late. Are you looking at anything to fix that?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Our trailer telematics vendor has a temperature add-on. It's cheap because we're already on their contract, but it only reports every 30 minutes, and it doesn't alert anybody at the stores.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: If you pick something, how would that decision get made?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: I'd recommend it. Ellen Ford, our VP of supply chain, approves it, and it does a security review on anything that sends data to the cloud.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: How long does that review usually take?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: About three weeks, and Vendor onboarding needs a certificate of insurance before anything gets installed.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Is there budget for this year or would it be next year?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Next year, it would go in the capital plan, and capital requests are due October 15th.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: So to make that plan, Ellen would need to see something before the 15th. What would she need?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Proof it works on our routes and alerts that reach the store and the night dispatcher within 10 minutes.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Here's what I'd suggest. I'll send our security packet and a proposal for a five-trailer pilot by next Wednesday so it can start early. Could you set up 30 minutes with Ellen after that?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: I can do that. I'll get Ellen on the calendar for the week after.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Great, I'll send everything by Wednesday. Thanks, Victor.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Thanks, Jenna.
